<b>Rite of the Pollip</b> is a [[Gather Wishes|Gather Wish]] in <i>[[Hollow Knight: Silksong]]</i>, started by talking to [[Greyroot]] in [[Shellwood]].

== Wish ==
[[File:Pollip Heart.png|link=Pollip Heart|left|thumb|100x100px]]

Greyroot asks for 6 [[Pollip Heart]]s to be gathered. They can be found near purple flowers growing around [[Shellwood]], some of which sprout large buds that can be destroyed to drop a single Pollip Heart. Once all 6 Pollip Hearts have been collected, they must be delivered back to Greyroot.

{{Gallery
| Image1 = Mapshot SS Greyroot.png!Location of Greyroot in Shellwood
| Image2 = Mapshot SS Pollip Heart.png!Locations of the Pollip Hearts in Shellwood
}}

== Reward ==
[[File:Pollip Pouch.png|link=Pollip Pouch|left|thumb|100x100px]]

After delivering the Pollip Hearts to Greyroot, they award [[Hornet (Silksong)|Hornet]] with the [[Pollip Pouch]], which applies venom to {{CrestSlot|Red|s}}.
